Rv2780 is a protein from M. tuberculosis that has been studied in the context of its interaction with host macrophages. In studies examining the subcellular localization of M. tuberculosis proteins in infected mouse macrophages, Rv2780 has been shown to localize to the cytoplasm of the host cell, consistent with it being an effector protein that is translocated into the macrophage cytoplasm during infection.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
